statement: On a fresh H2 database with an identity primary key, both versions return the same ordered integer keys for two known values inserted either in one statement or in two successive calls.

adapter.mapping: The boolean selects one two-row statement or two single-row inserts. An unnamed H2 database belongs to a fresh JDBC connection. The original rxjava-jdbc subscriber drains the keys and the adapter copies each returned integer at its original index.
